title: What will you build?
description: Describe a project, and the AI agent of your node builds it: a Web4 swarm of A2A agents, a large full-stack app or an app factory.

rootHome.heading: What will you build?

cards.title: Create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents
cards.text: The agents of your elements find each other and agents of other nodes, agree on the work and are paid through Lagrix.
cards.task: I want to create a Web4 swarm of A2A agents.

cards.title: Create a large full-stack app
cards.text: From idea to money 99% faster. Sign-in, data, design and blocks are already in the node, so the agent builds only your product.
cards.task: I want to create a large full-stack app.

cards.title: Create an app factory
cards.text: Make your own versions of popular products: the node studies how they work with reverse engineering and builds yours on their ideas.
cards.task: I want to create an app factory with my own versions of popular products.

accepted.title: Task accepted
accepted.text: It waits for your agent in the node. Connect Claude Code, and the agent starts with this task. Or connect Telegram, and the bot asks whether to start it.

rootHome.notArchitect: Only the architect of this node can hand a task to its agent. Sign in with the architect account.
rootHome.failed: The node did not take the task. Try again.
